build_mask_rcnn_outputs: build a python module to add Mask R-CNN mask logits or probabilities outputs to a detectron model
build_mask_rcnn_losses: build a python module to add SigmoidCrossEntropyLoss for mask predictions to a detectron model
build_mask_head_v1up4convs: build a python module to create a v1up mask head with 4 conv layers and transposed conv for upsampling
build_mask_head_v1up4convs_gn: build a python module to create a v1up mask head with 4 conv layers and GroupNorm for mask prediction
build_mask_head_v0upshare: build a python module to create a mask head that shares ResNet conv5 weights with the box head during training
